scientific.integrity: The all-order conclusion is obtained from a proved Fourier-aliasing bound plus outward-rounded interval checks of a finite range. Finite numerical checks are not used as a substitute for the infinite tail argument.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is for uniform finite-cyclic samples of the specific three-term pair at exponent three. The full 1996 Mockenhaupt thesis was unavailable for direct inspection; the closest comparison uses Krenedits' detailed published account of its numerical discrete inequality.

title: A finite-cyclic three-term majorant reversal exactly from order \(5\) onward
